subject.title: Feature request: per-pattern session maintenance retention rules

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `session.maintenance.rules` matcher for per-pattern or per-type age retention, and what matcher contract should it expose?
rationale: The requested fix adds public config and destructive cleanup semantics, so automation cannot safely choose raw key globs versus typed session-kind or metadata matching without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Approve typed retention rules
options.body: Add ordered first-match rules using stable typed match criteria, with global `pruneAfter` fallback and explicit preservation semantics.

options.title: Approve raw key globs
options.body: Implement the user-proposed glob-style matcher, accepting higher compatibility risk from exposing session-key internals as config API.

options.title: Defer broad rules
options.body: Do not add broad retention rules now; handle only narrower requests such as exact preservation or per-label retention in their own issues.

recommendation.title: Approve typed retention rules
recommendation.body: Add ordered first-match rules using stable typed match criteria, with global `pruneAfter` fallback and explicit preservation semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent maintainer history point to this person for the active session-maintenance/config surface.
